title: The synthesis of novel phosphonodipeptides and their herbicidal activity
abstract: AbstractA series of novel phosphonodipeptides has been synthesized from diphenyl α‐aminoalkylphosphonates and N‐chloroacetyl‐N‐alkyl (or aryl)glycine ethyl esters. The structures of all the compounds prepared were proved by 1H NMR, IR, MS, and elemental analyses. The bioassay tests showed that some of the compound have good herbicidal activity.
